youtube.title: Stop Writing match for Every Error in Rust 🦀 #shorts

scenes.say: What if Rust error handling took just one character?

scenes.heading: The long way
scenes.say: Here's the long way: a match that returns the error early, just to open a file.

scenes.heading: With ?
scenes.caption: Same behavior, way less code
scenes.say: With the question mark, Rust returns the error for you if something fails, and unwraps the value if it works.

scenes.heading: What ? actually does
scenes.say: On Ok, it hands you the value. On Err, it returns early, converting the error with From. And it works on Option too.
